jobs.title: PL|SQL Developer
jobs.description: Job Description: Database Development: Design and write efficient PL/SQL code, including stored procedures, packages, functions, views, and database triggers. Performance Tuning: Analyze complex queries, build strategic indexes, use optimizer hints, and utilize tools like AWR (Automatic Workload Repository), Explain Plan, and Profiler to eliminate database bottlenecks. Data Architecture & Modeling: Manage and design database schemas, tablespaces, entity-relationship diagrams (ERDs), and overall data structures to maintain data integrity. ETL and Data Migration: Build automated batch jobs using data transformation routines to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from external flat files or legacy systems into target databases. Collaboration: Work alongside data analysts, software engineering teams, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment to map business requirements into technical SQL logic.

They have the ability to understand what is needed to make designs, products, and user interfaces that are functional and easy to use, while having the skill to create a design aesthetically appealing to the client and end-user. They specialize in creating and laying out all the visual aesthetics of a design in whatever format is required to reach their target audience. Our Creative Web Designer should have those competencies, and naturally have working knowledge in art or design and be someone highly visual, curious, and creative by nature. Designing the multi-channel network and planning the implementation of new solutions (e.g., shops, lockers, digital points), ensuring alignment with the Country Project. 2. Manage local relationships with administrative/political bodies, and proactively advise on and execute physical partnerships and new business initiatives. 3. Execute land commercialization actions (sales or commercialization of vacant premises), following Asset Manager guidelines.
